done.why: It felt like standard Zork with the map rearranged. The gallery and studio south of the cellar were new, but nothing grabbed me in a few minutes.

about: A remixed Zork. You start at the white house, enter through the window, and take the lamp and sword. Below the trap door, the cellar connects to an art gallery and studio. You carry treasures to the trophy case for points.

moments.note: The cellar's south exit led to a chasm edge and then a gallery, not the usual map.
The chimney only allows the lamp and one other item, so I had to drop things.
Putting the painting in the case gave 45 points quickly.

wished: A clearer sign of what was different from the original
A stronger early hook or goal

lines.line: The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
lines.why: It is a familiar beat, and it signalled that I could not simply go back.

lines.line: Fortunately, there is still one chance for you to be a vandal, for on the far wall is a painting of unparalleled beauty.
lines.why: This is the funniest line I read, and it gave me a clear goal.

fun.why: It was brisk and I scored quickly, but little of it surprised me.

engagement.why: The map was mostly familiar, so I lost interest.

difficulty.why: Everything I tried worked on the first go.

interestingness.why: The altered geography near the cellar was intriguing.

prose.why: The prose was clean and mostly familiar, with a few good lines.
